rules.text: A change to headings 7801 through 7803 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.

A change to heading 7804 from any other heading, provided there is a regional value content of not less than 35 percent based on the build-up method or 45 percent based on the build-down method.
[TCR 13 deleted.]

(A) A change to bars, rods, profiles or wire of heading 7806 from other goods of heading 7806 or from any other heading; or
(B) A change to tubes, pipes and tube or pipe fittings of heading 7806 from any other goods of heading 7806 or from any other heading, provided that there is a regional value content of not less than:
(1) 35 percent based on the build-up method, or
(2) 45 percent based on the build-down method; or
(C) A change to other goods of heading 7806 from any other heading, provided there is a regional value content of not less than:
(1) 35 percent based on the build-up method, or
(2) 45 percent based on the build-down method.
